sources.text: Brazilian colonist cheese; the earlier source and the 'Colony cheese' alias are the Uruguayan Queso Colonia (Emmental-like, 4+ months), a different cheese

facts.v: Made by hand on German and Italian settler farms in southern Brazil: milk with salt and dairy starter, the curd not heated, then pressed
Named after the colonial farming system of the settler families (colonos), not the Portuguese colonial period
